name: GAN Mosaic Cubes 10x10 (Pack of 100)
description: This is a set of 100 3x3s with a display frame that you can use to make beautiful mosaics! The 3x3s are 28mm, tiled, and turn well right out of the box. The frame has an adjustable stand that tilts from 90 ° to 45 ° depending on how you want to display.
